name: How much does it cost to install new laundry room flooring?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install new laundry room flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of installing new laundry room flooring varies significantly based on material choice, room size, and labor rates. For example, luxury vinyl plank might range from $3 to $7 per square foot for materials, plus installation. Ceramic or porcelain tile can cost $5 to $15 per square foot for materials, with installation adding a substantial amount due to the specialized skills required. Get a detailed quote to understand the total project cost for your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on material, room size, and labor. Expect $3-$7 per sq ft for LVP materials and $5-$15 per sq ft for tile materials, plus installation.
